purpose: Test whether adding .depot/workflows to the default branch automatically registers a native Depot workflow and produces a native run for a matching push.

probe.sideEffects: none; both copies echo the commit SHA and upload no artifacts

depotWorkflowList.queryCommand: depot ci workflow list --repo Aquaticats/Monochromatic --name registration-probe --org l4zncjjbj5 --output json

result: The GitHub copy ran; no native Depot workflow was registered or run within about two minutes of the direct push to main.
cleanup: The probe workflows and marker were removed in commit f8bc2d6c67; the workflow list was empty before cleanup.
limits: One direct-push observation, not a PR-merge observation.
A two-minute observation window; asynchronous registration after that window was not observed.
No claim that automatic registration is impossible; only that this direct-to-main probe did not reproduce it.
